name: Matching System Reference 1 Choice
definition: Choice between a matching system unique identification or the related reference.

MatchingSystemUniqueReference.name: Matching System Unique Reference
MatchingSystemUniqueReference.definition: Reference to the unique system identification assigned to the trade by the central matching system.

RelatedReference.name: Related Reference
RelatedReference.definition: Refers to the identification of a previous event in the life of a trade which is amended or cancelled.
